technical.summary: Bullish structure with strong trend confirmation but overbought conditions and weak momentum divergence (MACD/OBV) limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: WRB shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings volatility risk in 11 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (31 Fear/Greed score) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3+ years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (399.84), flat yield curve, recent CPI miss (-2 days), and earnings in 11 days create severe macro headwinds for financials sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure (price above MAs, supertrend bullish, stoch cross) with contrarian sentiment opportunity in extreme fear zone (31 Fear/Greed) offers asymmetric risk/reward for disciplined swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI, MACD/OBV divergence, crisis VIX (399.84), high earnings risk in 11 days, zero fundamental conviction, and macro headwinds (flat yield curve, high credit spreads) create unacceptable risk for entry into a financial sector stock.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is constructive (price above MAs, supertrend bullish) and extreme fear presents contrarian opportunity, but overbought conditions (RSI 21, MACD divergence) combined with crisis macro environment make risk/reward unfavorable for new entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings volatility in 11 days combined with crisis VIX (399.84) and high credit spreads create severe tail risk; overbought technicals offer no margin of safety.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding WRB with 25 existing Financials positions (6% sector concentration); adding to this concentration during macro crisis and earnings proximity violates risk discipline.
